case.summary: Case CASE-005 involves three card-not-present transactions (4012171, 4012172, 4012173) on card SC-03005-K949 totaling $1,206.43 exposure. The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012171 at 0.83 [EV-addc089d]. The transactions originated from a new device (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0) and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-68c6f45c, EV-ec5095a0]. Velocity analysis shows three online transactions within 48 hours, above the card's historical average of $402.14 [EV-5719623a, EV-7e703e2b]. The device fingerprint appears in a prior confirmed fraud case and the customer has one previous fraud case CC-4320 [EV-f406b8be, EV-ba99c0d5]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and reports the physical card remains in their possession [EV-53683981]. The pattern matches six prior card_not_present_new_device cases [EV-bd50e657].

sar.narrative: Suspicious Activity Report for CASE-005 documents card-not-present fraud on card SC-03005-K949 with $1,206.43 exposure across three transactions. Real-time risk scoring flagged transaction 4012171 at 0.83 [EV-addc089d]. The transactions were initiated from a previously unseen device (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0) and routed through an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-68c6f45c, EV-ec5095a0]. Velocity monitoring identified three online transactions within a 48-hour window, exceeding the card's historical transaction average of $402.14 [EV-5719623a, EV-7e703e2b]. The device fingerprint has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer account has a previous fraud case CC-4320 [EV-f406b8be, EV-ba99c0d5]. The cardholder confirms they did not authorize the transactions and retains physical possession of the card [EV-53683981]. This pattern aligns with six prior card_not_present_new_device fraud cases retrieved by pattern and keyword matching [EV-bd50e657]. The investigation supports card reissue and enhanced monitoring for the affected account.
